prompt: How do I set up an automatic out-of-office reply in Outlook?
completion:
Setting up an automatic out-of-office reply in Outlook is a straightforward process. Here’s how you can do it:

### For Outlook on the Web (Outlook.com or Office 365):
1. **Sign in** to your Outlook account via a web browser.
2. **Click on the gear icon** (Settings) in the upper-right corner.
3. **Select "View all Outlook settings"** at the bottom of the menu.
4. **Go to the "Mail"** tab and then **"Automatic replies"**.
5. **Toggle the switch** to turn on automatic replies.
6. **Set the duration** for your out-of-office reply.
7. **Compose your message** in the provided text box.
8. **Click "Save"** to activate the out-of-office reply.

### For Outlook Desktop (Windows):
1. **Open Outlook** and go to the **File** menu.
2. **Select "Automatic Replies"** from the menu.
3. **Choose "Send automatic replies"** and set the duration.
4. **Compose your message** in the provided text box.
5. **Click "OK"** to save and activate the out-of-office reply.

### For Outlook Desktop (Mac):
1. **Open Outlook** and go to the **Tools** menu.
2. **Select "Out of Office"** from the menu.
3. **Choose "Send automatic replies"** and set the duration.
4. **Compose your message** in the provided text box.
5. **Click "OK"** to save and activate the out-of-office reply.

If you need more detailed instructions or run into any issues, feel free to ask!
